CREATE TABLE "public"."AccountAppeal" (
  "adminNote" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewedAt" timestamp(3),
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" "AppealStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"AppealStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ActiveUserReward" (
  "activeUserCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "claimedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "period" "RewardPeriod" NOT NULL,
  "periodEnd" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "periodStart" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "rewardAmount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" "AuditAction" NOT NULL,
  "adminId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "targetUserId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Deposit" (
  "amountPKR" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditAmountUSD" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "exchangeRate" numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentMethod" text DEFAULT 'Easypaisa' NOT NULL,
  "rejectedAt" timestamp(3),
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" "DepositStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"DepositStatus" NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EarningCollection" (
  "amount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "collectedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "investmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Investment" (
  "amount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dailyReturn" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "durationDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastCollectedAt" timestamp(3),
  "level1Percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "level2Percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "level3Percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "nextCollectionAt" timestamp(3),
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" "InvestmentStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"InvestmentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."InvestmentPlan" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dailyEarning" numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "depositAmount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "durationDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isSpecial" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "level1Percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "level2Percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "level3Percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "maxPurchasesPerUser" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "profitAmount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "referralBonusUSD" numeric(18,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "status" "PlanStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"PlanStatus" NOT NULL,
  "totalReturn" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PlatformSettings" (
  "adminTwoFactor" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "depositAccountName" text DEFAULT 'ClaudeInvest' NOT NULL,
  "depositAccountNumber" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "depositApprovalMaxHours" int4 DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL,
  "depositApprovalMinHours" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "depositCurrency" text DEFAULT 'PKR' NOT NULL,
  "depositInstructions" text DEFAULT 'Send payment to the account above and enter your transaction ID.' NOT NULL,
  "depositPaymentMethod" text DEFAULT 'Easypaisa' NOT NULL,
  "exchangeRate" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '300'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "maintenanceMode" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "platformCurrency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "platformName" text DEFAULT 'ClaudeInvest' NOT NULL,
  "supportEmail" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalApprovalMaxHours" int4 DEFAULT 2 NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalClosingHour" int4 DEFAULT 23 NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalCurrency" text DEFAULT 'PKR' NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalFeePercent" numeric(10,4) DEFAULT '12'::numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalFriday" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalMonday" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalOpeningHour" int4 DEFAULT 9 NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalSaturday" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalSunday" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalThursday" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalTuesday" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalWednesday" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ReferralCommission" (
  "beneficiaryId" text NOT NULL,
  "commissionAmount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "investmentAmount" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "investmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "level" "ReferralLevel" NOT NULL,
  "percent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "sourceUserId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Transaction" (
  "amountUSD" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "balanceAfter" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "balanceBefore" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "depositId" text,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "referenceId" text,
  "status" "TransactionStatus" DEFAULT 'COMPLETED'::"TransactionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "type" "TransactionType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "premiumBadge" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "publicUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "referralCode" text NOT NULL,
  "referredById" text,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'USER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Withdrawal" (
  "accountName" text NOT NULL,
  "amountUSD" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamp(3),
  "cnicNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "easypaisaNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "exchangeRate" numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "feePercent" numeric(10,4) NOT NULL,
  "feeUSD" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "netAmountUSD" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "payoutPKR" numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "rejectedAt" timestamp(3),
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "requestedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" "WithdrawalStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"WithdrawalStatus" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WithdrawalProfile" (
  "accountName" text NOT NULL,
  "cnicNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "easypaisaNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isLocked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
